label: GB-uk-gdpr-2016 Article 80

obligations.text: The data subject shall have the right to mandate a body or other organisation which meets the conditions in section 187(3) and (4) of the 2018 Act to make a complaint under section 164A or 165 of the 2018 Act on his or her behalf, to exercise the rights referred to in Articles ... 78 and 79 on his or her behalf, and to exercise the right to receive compensation referred to in Article 82 on his or her behalf ... .
